name: RT26_LayerContent
summary: Layer content target: at the selection ring's glow pass it held the ring layer's own (sharp) pixels in its atlas place; the glow shader reads it as its second texture.

behavior.text: the sharp ring (alpha up to 253) at atlas (66..135, 64..96); the glow composite reproduces the draw with this as B.

the layer draw target (row 0 slot 0 of the per-type target table) and slot 26 of the per-type slot table share one resource pointer; it is the target of every layer's own UI draws (UICommand_ExecuteBatches), cleared to (0, 0, 0, 0) per atlas page (GUILayer_Composite), and the source of the layer blit (GUILayer_BlitFinal reads RT 26 first). See the flow UiLayerComposite.

name: RT27_GlowBlurred
summary: Full-resolution blurred layer read by the glow pass (its first texture); for a half-size blur it is the bilinear upscale of RT32_HalfBlur.

behavior.text: equals the bilinear upscale of RT 32 (pixel centre x / 2 - 0.25 in half-size texels) with 8-bit stores rounding halves down: 0 of 27744 values differ.

name: RT28_BlurScratch
summary: Scratch target of the UI blur's horizontal pass (UIBlur_Run gets 28 as its scratch index from the drop-shadow pass).

behavior.text: GUILayer_BlurShadowPass passes scratch index 28 to UIBlur_Run; RT 28 is RGBA8 (live resource list).
the horizontal result is stored at 8 bits before the vertical pass reads it.

name: RT30_MaskBuffer
summary: Mask buffer of masked layers: the mask pass reads its red channel.

behavior.text: RT 30 is R8_UNORM at output size (live resource list); MaskComposite_PS reads mask.r.

name: RT32_HalfBlur
summary: Half-size blur target: first the 2 x 2 box downsample of the layer, finally the vertically blurred result. Heads a chain of smaller targets (RT 33..36: 320 x 180 down to 40 x 23).

behavior.text: the vertical pass (sigma = radius / 2) of RT37_HalfBlurTemp reproduces it to +-1 on 4 of 19200 values.

name: RT37_HalfBlurTemp
summary: Half-size blur scratch: holds the horizontal pass of the half-size blur. Heads a second chain (RT 38..41).

behavior.text: the horizontal pass (sigma 2) of the 2 x 2 box downsample of RT26_LayerContent reproduces it to +-1 on 40 of 9600 values.

name: RT3_EffectAlpha
summary: Effect alpha atlas: each layer with a drop shadow copies its alpha here (inside its atlas rectangle), the UI blur blurs it in place, and the shadow pass samples it. Reused during the frame: at frame end it no longer holds every layer's alpha.

behavior.text: before the name tag's shadow draw it held the blurred alpha of that layer and of the footer guides at their atlas places, plus other UI content.

name: UITarget_Frame
format: UNORM (8 bits per channel by the captures)
summary: The UI frame target: the render target every layer blit composites onto (GUILayer_BlitFinal, GUILayer_BlurShadowPass and the glow pass take it from the same per-type table entry, slot 2 of the 800-byte row of the layer's target type). Type 0 is the type of the main UI target.

behavior.text: the row of type 0 holds four target objects (slots 0..3); slot 0 is the layer draw target (RT 26's resource), slot 2 is a two-dimensional array view (the frame), slots 1 and 3 other views of the same size (1280 x 720).
UIRender_SubmitFrame reads the page count from slot 2's view (array size) to clear and transition one atlas texture per page.
slot 2 is the frame the finished UI is presented from: the blits write it, UIRender_ResolveBase copies the base surface into it first. Not traced to the swap chain here.

open_questions: ? the DXGI format of the resource (the shader sees it as a UNORM float4 UAV); how slot 2 reaches the swap chain.
